title: ReadinessReport
description: Emitted on stdout by provision-e2e-target.sh (with or without --check-only) and rendered into the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY of the generalized auto-update-spec-kit-scratch-preflight.yml workflow. See data-model.md. Tri-state outcome/verdict shape amended by specs/069-scratch-readiness-reporting/contracts/readiness-report.schema.json (FR-010/FR-011): elements[].ready (bool) is replaced by elements[].outcome (tri-state), and top-level ready (bool) is replaced by verdict (tri-state).

outcome.description: The three outcomes a machine consumer must be able to tell apart without parsing remaining_action. not_checkable means the checking route's credential cannot answer this element at all -- never folded into missing.

remaining_action.description: Null iff outcome is 'ready'. Never null otherwise (FR-006). For outcome 'not_checkable', names the route that can check this element instead (FR-005).

verdict.description: all_clear iff every element is ready; not_clear if any element is missing (checked-and-missing outranks unverified); unverified iff nothing is missing but at least one element is not_checkable. Never all_clear with a missing or not_checkable element present. Maps 1:1 to provision-e2e-target.sh's exit status: 0 / 1 / 2 respectively (see contracts/cli.md).
